title: Boots sold for $8.9bn to billionaire family behind Primark
summary: Private equity firm Sycamore Partners and Stefano Pessina, former Executive Chairman of Boots, have sold the UK health and beauty retailer to Canada’s Weston family in a multi-billion-dollar deal

extraction.key_fact: 영국의 헬스앤뷰티 유통 체인 부츠가 캐나다의 웨스턴 가문에 매각되었다.
